summary: Learn how social entrepreneurship can transform rural communities. Join our training course to gain skills and insights for impactful development.
lede: Social entrepreneurship in rural development uses sustainable business approaches to address local challenges and support livelihoods. It is for development practitioners, community enterprise leaders and social entrepreneurs seeking to turn rural needs into viable ventures. The course covers framing community problems, designing business models that balance income and impact, and planning funding, growth and impact measurement.
audienceIntro: Designed for professionals, leaders, and innovators driving change in rural and social sectors, this course is ideal for those who are passionate about creating sustainable livelihoods and fostering inclusive growth.
audience: Government officers in rural development programs
Educators and trainers in enterprise development
Researchers and consultants in inclusive growth
modules: Innovation and Technology for Rural Solutions
Action Planning and Pitching Social Ventures
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of rural development issues and some experience in social projects or entrepreneurship. Familiarity with business concepts will be beneficial, but not mandatory.
